instruction: I would like to center-align the first paragraph of my tutorial guidelines document to make it stand out as an introductory statement. Please change the alignment of the first paragraph to center.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the alignment of the first paragraph to center. The evaluator extracts the alignment property from the first non-empty paragraph and checks if it matches CENTER alignment. Returns 1.0 if aligned to center, 0.0 otherwise.

Metric parameter handling is correct: expected receives rules dict directly from get_rule(), accesses 'target_alignment' appropriately
Complete instruction coverage: task requires center-aligning first paragraph, evaluator verifies first paragraph has CENTER alignment
